contracts.detail: Before (pre-patch, except Exception): test_zstopen_closes_fileobj_on_base_exception FAILS — fileobj.closed is False because KeyboardInterrupt bypasses the Exception-only except clause. After (post-patch, except:): test PASSES — fileobj.closed is True because bare except catches KeyboardInterrupt and closes fileobj before re-raising. This is an intentional, beneficial breach: a resource leak (file descriptor not closed on BaseException) is fixed.

behavior_differences.before: test_zstopen_closes_fileobj_on_base_exception: FAIL — AssertionError: False is not true (opened[0].closed is False; ZstdFile fileobj NOT closed when taropen raises KeyboardInterrupt)
behavior_differences.after: test_zstopen_closes_fileobj_on_base_exception: PASS — opened[0].closed is True; ZstdFile fileobj IS closed when taropen raises KeyboardInterrupt
behavior_differences.evidence: Contract verification: pre-patch ('except Exception') fails test, post-patch ('except:') passes test. Coverage confirms patch line 2132 (except:) is executed. Behavior difference confirmed via identical test input run against before/after builds.

notes: Patch modifies only 1 line: 'except Exception:' -> 'except:' at Lib/tarfile.py:2132
The bare except is intentional per commit message: 'This is one of those times when a bare except is appropriate.'
Resource cleanup improvement: fileobj.close() now occurs on all exception types including BaseException subclasses
Uncovered context lines 2129-2131 are in the ZstdError/EOFError handler, not modified by this patch

conclusion.rationale: 补丁修改了 TarFile.zstopen 的异常处理行为：将 `except Exception:` 改为裸 `except:`，使得 BaseException 子类（如 KeyboardInterrupt、SystemExit）也能触发 fileobj.close() 资源清理。这是一个可观察的行为变化，技术上与旧行为不兼容——依赖补丁前 KeyboardInterrupt 路径中 fileobj 保持打开的代码会观察到差异。然而，这是一个正向的资源泄漏修复：裸 except 仅用于关闭文件对象后重新抛出异常，不吞没异常，不影响正常异常传播路径。覆盖率 100%（1/1 补丁行已覆盖），契约验证确认了前后行为差异。
recommended_actions: 该变更是资源泄漏修复，对绝大多数用户透明无害
